_comment: IPO lockup expirations per the PRIMARY S-1. Surfaced in the Ask box; ipo_lockup_alert.py fires a Telegram alert 14d before each tranche. Day-count dates are exact from the prospectus date; earnings-tied dates are approximate (move with the actual report date) and flagged approx:true.

SPCX.structure: THREE groups: (1) 180-day lock-up group with early releases from Q3-2026; (2) a larger EXTENDED group (~7.8B sh, ~63% of shares, non-Musk) locked until Q2-2027 earnings with releases starting Q4-2026 earnings; (3) Mr. Musk — 366-day lock, NO early release (all ~6.4B his shares + together with extended = ~63% locked >1yr).

tranches.desc: Q2-2026 earnings (First Earnings Release Date, qtr ended Jun 30 2026) → up to 20% of the 180-day-group shares (~911.5M sh)

tranches.conditional: SPCX >= $175.50 (30% over $135 offer) for 5 of 10 days ending on the First Earnings Release Date
tranches.desc: BONUS +10% of 180-day-group shares — ONLY if the price condition is met at Q2 earnings
Q3-2026 earnings (qtr ended Sep 30 2026) → further release of 180-day-group shares
Day 180 — remainder of the 180-day group comes off restriction
EXTENDED group: Q4-2026 earnings (qtr ended Dec 31 2026) → up to 20% of the ~7.8B extended-group shares
EXTENDED: Q1-2027 earnings (qtr ended Mar 31 2027) → +20% of extended group
MR. MUSK lockup expiry (366 days) — ALL his shares (~6.4B Class A incl. conversions). NO early-release provisions apply to Musk.
EXTENDED group fully released after Q2-2027 earnings (qtr ended Jun 30 2027) — remaining extended shares

SPCX.notes: EXACT terms from S-1/A on SEC EDGAR (CIK 0001181412, accession 0001628280-26-040364, filed 2026-06-03). Day-count tranches are exact from the prospectus date (offering 2026-06-12); earnings-tied tranches are approximate and move with SpaceX's actual report dates. KEY: the BULK of insider shares (~63%, the extended group + Musk) stays locked into 2027 — only the smaller 180-day group releases in 2026. Underwriters (Goldman Sachs) can waive early. Index forced-buys (S&P/Nasdaq) are a separate supply event.
